name: stiff_exponential_pair
source:
{ A deliberately ill-conditioned simultaneous pair: one equation is nearly flat
  in y while the other is nearly flat in x, so the Jacobian is close to singular
  at the start point and the solve depends on the retry ladder holding up. }
GUESS x = 1
GUESS y = 1
exp(x) + 1e-6 * y = 3
1e-6 * x + exp(y) = 5
